title: Memory Studio: personal cards and scheduled recall
summary: Adds editable personal flashcards, four recall ratings, persisted SM-2-based review scheduling and entry points from Home and personal lessons.

changes.detail: Personal question/answer and cloze-style prompts with reveal-before-rating, collection search and paginated display.
Validated additive progress migration with card scheduling parameters and review events; self-ratings do not inflate mastery.
Home and personal lesson notes link to Memory Studio. Existing progress, authentication, navigation and courses retained.

validation.name: Implementation

validation.name: Release limits
validation.detail: No deployment, live AI call, device check or cloud migration. Cards are user-authored; no AI card generation, matching games or memory palace added.
